info.description: The routes of the `seocart/v1` namespace, and of the Store API, `seocart/store/v1`, whose paths name their own server. Each operation is generated from the same declaration as its ability and its WP-CLI command, which docs/reference/ describes. A request authenticates as a WordPress user, with a REST nonce or an application password, and each operation names the capability it requires. A Store API operation requires none: anyone may send a read, and a write must satisfy the Store API's request policy.

post.summary: Switches the request's cart to another currency the store sells in, at the cart version the client read: the switch moves the version on, drops the checkout's shipping and tax quotes, keeps the shipping method chosen, and answers the cart priced in the new currency; a switch to the currency the cart is in already is accepted like any other. post.summary: Places an order from the request's cart, at the cart version and for the grand total the client read, and has its payment authorized; the Idempotency-Key header is required. A retry with the same key never places a second order: it is answered 200 with the placement as it stands now, the same order and order key, its outcome and statuses as the settlement left them, and a declined placement is answered so too, with the outcome declined, since refusals are not kept.

post.summary: Creates an active location with its name and, optionally, its address, phone, what it does, its priority and its pickup hours; the store's first location becomes its default.

name.description: The name the merchant gives the location, such as Main warehouse; not blank.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, two capital letters, such as GB. It appears on customer-facing documents.

line1.description: The first address line. It appears on customer-facing documents.

line2.description: The second address line, empty when there is none. It appears on customer-facing documents.

city.description: The city or town. It appears on customer-facing documents.

region.description: The state, province, county or other subdivision, empty when there is none. It appears on customer-facing documents.

postcode.description: The postal code. It appears on customer-facing documents.

address.description: Where the location is; given, it replaces the whole address. It is public: it appears on customer-facing documents, such as pickup confirmations, packing slips and shipping labels.

phone.description: The location's phone number for the merchant's staff; on a change, an empty text removes it. It is personal data, shown only to a user who may see personal data.

fulfils_online.description: Whether the location ships online orders; a new location does unless told otherwise.

offers_pickup.description: Whether shoppers may collect orders at the location; a new location does not unless told otherwise.

pickup_ready_in.description: How soon a pickup order is usually ready: one of 1h, 2h, next_business_day, 2_4_days.

pickup_instructions.description: What a shopper collecting an order is told, such as where to go; it may run over several lines, and on a change an empty text removes it.
examples: Ring the bell at the side door.

priority.description: Where the location stands when an order is routed: the lowest number is tried first, and locations of the same number in the order they were created; a new location has 0 unless told otherwise.

weekday.description: The day of the week, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.

opens_at.description: When the location opens that day, local time, written HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

closes_at.description: When it closes that day, local time, written HH:MM, later than it opens.

hours.description: The days the location is open for pickup, each day once; given, they replace the location's hours, and a day not listed is closed.

order_uuid.description: The order whose unreconciled money was cleared.

has_unreconciled_money.description: Whether the order holds money a person must reconcile: false once cleared.

money_reconciled_at.description: When the flag was cleared, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond, by the database clock.

intent_uuid.description: The public identifier of the payment, as its order's payment record names it.

outcome.description: applied, or duplicate when another request had made the same capture or void a moment before.

payment_status.description: How far the payment's order is paid now.

amount_minor.description: What the gateway captured, or released for a void, in minor units of the payment's currency.

order_uuid.description: The order's public identifier, by which its status is read.

order_number.description: The number shown to people on the order and in its emails.

order_key.description: The order's access key, which reads its status without a login when the status read's header input carries it. It is shown in this answer, and again to a retry of the same request only: to the holder of the cart token and of the idempotency key it was placed with, since the store keeps the key only as a hash and sealed with those two, which it never keeps. Send a random idempotency key, such as a UUID. A retry whose kept key cannot be opened is answered without it; the client must keep it.

cart_version.description: The cart's version once the order was placed.

outcome.description: What the placement came to: approved, requires_action when the shopper must act, processing while the gateway decides, or, given to a retry with the same key, any outcome the placement came to since, declined included; pending only while the payment is not yet known.

status.description: The order's status once the placement settled.

payment_status.description: How far the order is paid once the placement settled.

type.description: redirect, to send the shopper to url; or sdk, to give client_token to the provider's script in the browser.

url.description: The page to send the shopper to, as the provider gave it; null for a step the provider's script takes.

client_token.description: The handle the provider's script in the browser needs, the browser's key to this payment at the provider: keep it out of every URL and log. Null when the step needs none.

next_action.description: What the shopper must do for the payment provider while the outcome is requires_action, for example confirm the payment with their bank, and null otherwise. It is answered again to a retry of the same request while the shopper must act. Once the provider sends the shopper back, resume the payment with checkout.resume_payment.

post_id.description: The product's post in the locale.

variant_id.description: The variant the listing shows: the enabled variant of the lowest position; null for a product whose variants are all disabled, which doctor reports.

sku.description: The SKU of that variant, or null when there is none.

title.description: The title of the product's post, as WordPress displays it, so it may hold HTML entities.

permalink.description: The address of the product's post.

url.description: The address of the image at the medium size, or at its full size when it has no medium size.

alt.description: The image's alternative text, empty when it has none.

image.description: The post's featured image at the medium size, or null for a post without one.

availability.description: Whether the product is in stock at any location that ships online orders: in_stock, out_of_stock, or unknown while its stock has not been summarized.

items.description: The products of the page, newest first: each one whose post in the locale is published and whose product is complete.

per_page.description: How many products a page holds.

has_more.description: Whether at least one more product follows this page.

refund_uuid.description: The refund's public identifier, which the gateway received as its idempotency key.

total_minor.description: What the refund gave back, tax included, in minor units of the order's currency.

tax_minor.description: The tax the refund gave back, in minor units of the order's currency.

shipping_minor.description: The shipping the refund gave back, before tax, in minor units of the order's currency.

base_total_minor.description: The total in minor units of the base currency, at the order's own rate.

base_currency.description: The store's base currency when the order was placed, ISO 4217.

note.description: What the person who refunds writes about the refund; kept with it, and refused when it holds a card number.

line_uuid.description: The public identifier of the order line.

quantity.description: How many of the line's units to give back.

restock.description: Whether the units go back into stock: recorded with the refund, not yet acted on; when absent, they do not.

lines.description: The units of each line the refund was asked for, in the order of the lines' identifiers.

refund_uuid.description: The refund whose claim was settled.

state.description: How the claim ended: recorded, the refund recorded; declined, no money given back, so the same refund asked again is a new one; or unreconciled, money left for a person to reconcile.

decided_by.description: What decided how the claim ended: gateway, when the payment gateway made or declined the refund, or statement, when it could not say and the person's statement decided.

gateway_reading.description: What the payment gateway said when it was asked once more: approved, declined, not_found, cannot_say, or unavailable, with why after a colon when known, such as unavailable:not_registered.

has_unreconciled_money.description: Whether the order holds money a person must reconcile now: true after a refund recorded on a person's statement, until a person clears it.

outcome.description: What the payment came to: approved, declined, requires_action while the shopper still must act, processing while the provider decides, or duplicate when the store had settled it already; the statuses say where the order stands.

payment_status.description: How far the order is paid now.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the store keeps its accounts in, in upper case.

cross_zone_policy.description: What stays fixed when a price entered including tax is sold where the tax rate differs from the store's own: fixed_net keeps the price before tax, fixed_gross keeps the price paid.

tax_rounding_mode.description: Where tax is rounded: per_line rounds each line's tax, per_subtotal rounds the tax of the lines of one tax class once and shares it out to them.

order_agent_per_order.description: The most an order agent may give back of one order, all of its refunds together, as an amount of the base currency in major units, such as 250.00; empty for no cap.

order_agent_per_day.description: The most an order agent may ask the payment gateway to give back in any 24 hours, of any orders, as an amount of the base currency in major units, such as 1000.00; empty for no cap.

multi_location_fulfilment.description: What happens when no one location can ship a whole order: split ships it from several locations, transfer accepts it and brings its units to one location before it ships, refuse refuses it at checkout.

transfer_lead_days.description: The days a shopper is told an order adds when its units must first be brought to one location.

transfer_warning_days.description: The days a transfer an order waits for may stay requested before it is flagged.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant whose stock is adjusted.

on_hand.description: The units physically in stock after the change.

allocated.description: The units promised to accepted orders.

held.description: The units held by checkouts, expired holds included until they are reclaimed.

available.description: The units that may still be promised: on hand, less allocated, less held. Negative when fewer units were counted than are promised or held.

ledger_entry_id.description: The id of the stock ledger entry that records the change.

track.description: Whether the variant's stock is counted; a variant whose stock is not counted is always for sale.

backorder_policy.description: What a sale may do once the variant's units run out: no, notify or allow.

low_stock_threshold.description: The units available at or below which the variant counts as low on stock, or null for none.

for_sale.description: The units shoppers may buy now, as the storefront counts them over the locations that ship online orders; null when nothing limits a sale, because the stock is not counted or backorders are allowed.

on_hand.description: The units physically in stock there.

allocated.description: The units there promised to accepted orders.

held.description: The units there held by checkouts, expired holds included until they are reclaimed.

available.description: The units there that may still be promised: on hand, less allocated, less held. Negative when fewer units were counted than are promised or held.

locations.description: The variant's units at each active location, zeros where it has no stock item yet, and at each inactive location that still has one, in the order orders are routed to them.

variants.description: The variants that have stock, by ascending id.

kind.description: Who started the transfer: manual for a merchant's, order for one an order waits for, deactivation for the move of a deactivated location's stock.

state.description: Where the transfer stands: draft, requested, in_transit, received or cancelled.

source_location_uuid.description: The location the units leave, or null when it no longer exists.

destination_location_uuid.description: The location the units arrive at, or null when it no longer exists.

order_id.description: The order the transfer brings units to, for one of kind order; null otherwise.

note.description: The merchant's note on the transfer, such as a tracking number, or null for none.

created_at.description: When the transfer was created, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond, by the database clock.

sent_at.description: When its units left the source, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond; null until it is sent.

received_at.description: When its last units were received or written off, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond; null until then.

line_id.description: The line, as a receipt names it.

quantity.description: The units the line sends, or sent.

received_quantity.description: The units received at the destination so far.

lost_quantity.description: The units written off as lost so far.

in_transit.description: The units on the way: sent, and neither received nor lost yet; 0 before the transfer is sent.

allocated.description: Whether the line carries, or carried until it was received, an order's units; such a line cannot be edited or removed.

lines.description: The transfer's lines, by ascending variant.

kind.description: Who started the transfer: manual for a merchant's, order for one an order waits for, deactivation for the move of a deactivated location's stock.

state.description: Where the transfer stands: draft, requested, in_transit, received or cancelled.

source_location_uuid.description: The location the units leave, or null when it no longer exists.

destination_location_uuid.description: The location the units arrive at, or null when it no longer exists.

order_id.description: The order the transfer brings units to, for one of kind order; null otherwise.

note.description: The merchant's note on the transfer, such as a tracking number, or null for none.

created_at.description: When the transfer was created, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond, by the database clock.

sent_at.description: When its units left the source, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond; null until it is sent.

received_at.description: When its last units were received or written off, UTC, in ISO 8601 to the microsecond; null until then.

lines.description: How many lines the transfer has.

sent.description: The units of every line together: what the transfer sends, or sent once it is in transit.

received.description: The units received so far, every line together.

lost.description: The units written off as lost, every line together.

transfers.description: The page of transfers, newest first.

per_page.description: How many transfers a page holds.

has_more.description: Whether a next page has transfers; no total is counted.

order_number.description: The number shown to people on the order and in its emails; a request never names an order by it.

status.description: Where the order is in its life, from pending payment to completed.

payment_status.description: How far the order has been paid, or refunded.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code of the currency every amount is in.

subtotal_minor.description: The lines before discounts, in minor units.

grand_total_minor.description: The order's total, in minor units.

paid_minor.description: What has been captured so far, in minor units.

refunded_minor.description: What has been refunded so far, in minor units.

due_minor.description: What is still to be paid, in minor units.

title.description: The product's name as it was sold.

variant_label.description: The variant as it was sold, such as a size; empty for a product without variants.

sku.description: The SKU as it was sold.

unit_price_minor.description: The price of one unit as authored, in minor units.

unit_amount_basis.description: Whether the unit price was authored net or gross of tax.

line_subtotal_minor.description: The unit price times the quantity, before discounts, in minor units.

line_discount_minor.description: The discounts given on the line, in minor units.

line_tax_minor.description: The tax on the line after discounts, in minor units.

line_total_minor.description: The line's total as the order shows it, in minor units.

lines.description: The order's lines, in their order.

nonce.description: A fresh wp_rest nonce for the user the request was authenticated as. Send it as the X-WP-Nonce header of the next request.

user_id.description: The WordPress user the request was authenticated as; 0 for a guest, and for a request that carried a login cookie without a nonce.
